visibility: All observations in this file are public; no blind-holdout claim.

records.measurement: Reaction is suppressed in the presence of TEMPO, BHT or p-benzoquinone; a TEMPO adduct is detected by HRMS.
DMPO suppresses product formation; a DMPO adduct is detected with supporting EPR signals.
records.source: main PDF p5 Scheme3b and p7 Fig3; SI PDFpp94–96

records.measurement: Using hydroxyl-18O-labelled 1a gives an 18O-labelled sulfinyl oxygen in the product.
Adding H2-18O under the reported conditions gives unlabelled product.

The Boc-protected hydroxyl derivative furnishes a product retaining the protecting group (reported isolated yield67%); the sulfinyl rearrangement of the unprotected substrate is not observed for that derivative.
